paper_title: Dark Matter Axion Search with HAYSTAC Phase II
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, converted from |g_gamma/g_gamma^KSVZ| using g_agamma = (alpha/pi)*|g_gamma|*m_a/Lambda^2 with |g_gamma^KSVZ|=0.97, Lambda=77.6 MeV
notes: HAYSTAC Phase IIc/d haloscope search. Paper reports aggregate 90% CL exclusions: |g_gamma| >= 2.75x KSVZ over 17.28-18.44 ueV (Phase IId) and |g_gamma| >= 2.96x KSVZ over 18.71-19.46 ueV (Phase IIc). Data points are the band endpoints for each subphase, converted to absolute g_agamma [GeV^-1] using the KSVZ relation with the paper's stated Lambda=77.6 MeV and |g_gamma^KSVZ|=0.97. Mode crossings at 17.89-18.08 ueV and 18.13-18.18 ueV plus 12 narrow RFI windows are excluded from the limit. Combined Phase II aggregate: 2.86x KSVZ over 16.96-19.46 ueV. Local DM density assumed 0.45 GeV/cm^3.
